Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Aarav - 8 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Naira - 10 years, daughter
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
3. Meenakshi - 41 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Tanay - 9 years, friend
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Aarav stands in the living room. Naira, Meenakshi and Tanay stand near him.]

Naira: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aarav puts on his school uniform.]

Aarav (laughing): "Oh wow!"

[Aarav combs his hair in front of the mirror.]

Aarav (gently): "Let's see."

[Aarav puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Meenakshi (happily): "Good job, Tanay!"

[Naira applies kajal to her eyes.]

Naira (happily): "What next?"

[Naira puts on red lipstick.]

Naira: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Naira puts a bindi on her forehead.]

Tanay: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Tanay: "What a nice place."

[Aarav walks across the courtyard.]

Tanay: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav searches for his lost ball.]

Meenakshi: "Hey, look at that!"

[Aarav shakes his head.]

Meenakshi: "What a day to remember!"
